categories.title: Save Point
categories.info: Interact with save points to replenish Sora's health, make a manual save, or travel to new worlds.

categories.title: Lucky Emblem
categories.info: Use Sora's camera to reveal a "Hidden Mickey" in the environment. These sneaky collectibles often require creative perspectives to line up all elements of the Lucky Emblem.

categories.title: Battlegate
categories.info:
After finishing the main story, return to previous worlds to find new combat scenarios for Sora to face. Interact with the blue spiked orb to start the challenge.

Complete all Battlegates to unlock a secret boss.

categories.title: Classic Kingdom
categories.info:
A trip down memory lane! These mini-games mimic classic Game & Watch handhelds from the 1980's. 

Found by opening chests or examining game posters. Once obtained, they can be played anytime from the Gummiphone menu. Play all Classic Kingdom games at least once to earn the **Classic Tone Keyblade**.

categories.title: Flantastic Seven
categories.info:
Keep an eye out for large fruit sitting atop a crown pedestal! Summon the Flan Heartless with the "Boinnng!" Command.

Each of the Flantastic Seven have a unique fruit reward, which you'll need for the recipes at Little Chef’s Bistro in Traverse Town. If you reach ????, the Flan will also unlock a unique ability for Sora!

categories.title: Mini-Game
categories.info: Take a break from following your heart's guiding key and play some games!

categories.title: Ingredient
categories.info:
Want to cook meals at Little's Chef's [Le Grand Bistrot](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-hearts-3/maps/twilight-town?locationIds=386585) in Traverse Town? Sora will need ingredients first!

Ingredients can be found by harvesting plants via Command prompts or striking food sources. They will respawn after exiting and re-entering a world.

locations.title: Lucky Emblem
locations.description:
**#06**

First, find and enter a Gigas suit. This is easiest during the Gigas tutorial fight, where you're automatically given one. Then, while in the suit, use the Blaster to destroy the stack of boxes on the circular display platform. Underneath all the boxes, the Lucky Emblem is in the center of the platform.

locations.title: Lucky Emblem

To the left of the store entrance, there's a stack of cardboard boxes on a cart. Line up the two blue "Out Now" signs with the round "Vic the Visitor" logo on the cardboard box.

locations.title: Lucky Emblem
locations.description:

Let the vent fan propel you up, then direct your fall towards the vent path halfway down. From the ledge, look back across at the vent wall.

locations.title: Lucky Emblem

locations.title: Lucky Emblem
locations.description:
**#08**

From the railing of Main Floor: 3F, jump down to the UFO hanging above the first floor gumball machine. Drop down onto the UFO, and snap a photo of the Lucky Emblem on its escape hatch.

locations.title: Lucky Emblem

locations.title: Angelic Amber
locations.description:
In the team's search for Hamm, they stumble upon a possessed doll. Battle begins when examining the doll house on display in the shop window. 

Amber will rag doll-float throughout the shop. Almost all her attacks are area-of-effect, except for when she torpedoes toward you. So, whenever the giant doll stops abruptly, shoots straight up, or does any other sudden movement—dodge roll away to get out of range.

locations.title: Mag Blocks
locations.description:
During the Kid Korral section of Toy Box, Sora will need to use a Giga suit's Mag Assembly to create a path with green blocks.

Follow the padded play house until you reach the room adjacent to the ball pit. Destroy all the Heartless, then move the blocks.
